classes.description: DataTransport — 数据传输通道配置。定义 Camstar 与外部系统通信的传输通道配置，支持多种传输类型的连接参数（SMTP邮件、FTP文件传输、WebService调用等），包含URL、认证凭据、超时设置、同步/异步模式等完整配置。被 Site、Factory、Organization、ResourceDef 等实体引用，用于各自的对外通信场景。 【Swagger】Schema: DataTransportEntity；来源文件: DataTransports.json；API: /api/DataTransports。

properties.name: smtpDomain
properties.description: 物理字段 SMTPDomain

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 关联的建模访问权限（A_SetupAccess）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: byteOrderMark
properties.description: 是否在文件编码中添加 BOM 标记

properties.name: priority
properties.description: 优先级

properties.name: labelFormat
properties.description: 标签格式

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注说明 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: remoteFileName
properties.description: 远程目标文件名

properties.name: name
properties.description: 传输通道唯一名称（必填） 【Swagger】Unique name for this instance

properties.name: transportType
properties.description: 传输类型（如 SMTP、FTP、WebService、File 等） 【Swagger】Method of sending document (e.g. FTP, HTTP, MQSeries, Socket, etc.)

properties.name: url
properties.description: 目标服务端点 URL（最长512字符） 【Swagger】Path to router

properties.name: userName
properties.description: 认证用户名 【Swagger】The User Name refers to the User that will be authenticated when the document is sent using this transport. For instance against an FTP site.

properties.name: password
properties.description: 认证密码（加密存储） 【Swagger】Password

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: transferType
properties.description: 传输方式类型

properties.name: isSynchronous
properties.description: 是否为同步传输模式 【Swagger】Specifies if the data transport is synchronous or asynchronous. i.e. if the XMLConnectPropogator is supposed to wait till the doc is delivered (delivery confirmation) to update the document's delivery status or not to wait.

properties.name: transportAssembly
properties.description: 传输实现组件/程序集名称 【Swagger】The name of the assembly responsible for the transport system connection

properties.name: connectionDocInit
properties.description: 连接初始化配置文档内容（最长4000字符） 【Swagger】The XML document that specifies the required connection parameters for the transport type.

properties.name: deliveryTimeout
properties.description: 投递超时时间（秒）

properties.name: connectionTimeout
properties.description: 连接超时时间（秒）

properties.name: remotePath
properties.description: 远程目标文件路径

properties.name: okToTerminateIfFails
properties.description: 失败时是否允许终止事务 【Swagger】This flag specifies whether to exclude the particular data transport (i.e. destination) if it fails to deliver the document (first time), or should the server keep trying and generating related error message into the event log for next documents with the same destination.

properties.name: useSsl
properties.description: 物理字段 UseSSL

properties.name: port
properties.description: 连接端口号

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list
